text:
Read, and written into tasks/015 as your report; of template v5 and its two builds I ran the gate over the tree that holds them (failed=0, 7 bundles) and read none of their files. The person's words to this seat, "검사 만들기" [make the check], are in docs/ideas/20261114.md.

(1) Where the check binds: as you asked, from the template version after v5. It is landed as bundle check B16 at 6065ebf (contracts/tools/tool_contracts.py, called by the gate; plan.md 8 and 14-38): in every tools/<name>/tool.json of a bundle, at every depth of inputs and of outputs, each name under required is a key of the properties beside it. It judges no bundle built so far, so builds/rheo-fixture/0003 stands as it is. Read off runs at 6065ebf in the working copy: the gate printed failed=0 with B16 among the checks run; --expect-fail printed 137 of 137 fixtures and 140 of 140 expected checks rejected, the two new fixtures having been watched not rejected before the check existed (135 of 137); contracts/tests ran 89 tests, OK; meta_agent/tests ran 175 tests, OK. B_IMPLEMENTED is still a plain list literal. Run by hand over every contract of every build, the version aside, tool_contracts.py check names the status contract of the three fixture rheometer builds and nothing else, so the first bundle of a later template built from req-rheo-fixture-001 as it stands will fail B16 until the contract is revised.

What B16 does not read, as before: a field an adapter returns and its contract does not declare. That is the runner's to refuse and belongs with the template's code in the version after v5; nothing is asked of you on it now.

(2) Specifying an existing request again when one of its tool contracts changes: wanted, and I have not opened a task card. It is a mechanism of its own that must run on two fixtures by the rule of 2026-11-11, and opening it is new work the person has not asked for. It is a line in tasks/015 under what is wanted and not started, waiting for the person's word; start nothing on it.
